chunks.content: 极光站 4B 接驳车运营手册，2026 秋季正式版。北门到观测台的末班车在 21:42 从北门发车。夜班安排只适用于工作日。
极光站 4B 接驳车旧版试运营方案。北门到观测台的末班车时间为 21:24。该安排已于 2026 年夏末废止。
新版 4B 东门线路的末班车在 21:48 发车。东门和北门是两条独立路线。
在秋季正式版中，北门末班车的导乘标识为 NORTH-OWL。临时调度记录使用 ROUTE-4B。
大风警报期间，观测台站点暂停上下客，乘客改由北门服务中心换乘。未规定警报期间的替代班次时刻。
北门工作日首班车 06:26。北门站点按启明广场入口标识指引。
平台无障碍坡道位于检票口北侧。坡道开放与接驳车时刻无关。
导航终端启动状态为 NAV-AWAKE。这个标识对应调度员桌面和显示状态。
极光站 4B 正式线路中，若乘客忘记携带实体票，终端可读取搭车码 STAR-QR。搭车码须在发车前完成核验。
4B 灰度线路先前使用登车码 PILOT-QR。灰度运行仅在内测周进行，正式线路使用另一套登车程序。
观测台团体预约需在 4 个工作日前提交申请。接驳车不自动延长该期限。
夜间服务台可借出无线电对讲机。晚间交还设备的地点是北门服务中心。
4B 工作日终点站到达后，遗失物将放入 NIGHT-BOX 留存柜。设备故障报修不是这项流程。
乘客因广播系统提示改乘时，站内短信通知包含一个单独的换乘令牌。其格式未在手册中提供。
北门服务中心失物招领柜的钥匙由值班员登记交接。紧急情况下可联系保安。
票据报销通过平台导出行程凭证，输出文件的编码为 UTF-8。
芦苇温室 P3 夏季控制手册。温室以高湿模式运行时，循环风扇保持 68 转每分钟。带土育苗区使用另一套档位。
芦苇温室 P3 中控冬季方案，高湿模式的循环风扇每分钟 86 转。该方案仅用于冬季保温。
P2 夏季高湿模式下循环风扇保持 58 转每分钟。P2 手册不能覆盖 P3 设置。
P3 夏季校准失去网络时，操作员应查找传感器面板上的离线指示灯 REED-OFFLINE，根据灯色确认状态。
P3 冬季校准失去网络时，操作员应查找同一面板上的指示灯 REED-FROST。其采样逻辑在冬季加载。
室内二氧化碳记录按每分钟一次的固定频率写入日志。日志没有记载网络恢复时限。
高湿模式下，地下滴灌关闭时报告 DRIP-IDLE。这个状态与地面环流风扇的运行状态分开。
维护工单合并后自动通知区域巡检员。需要更换电池时可借叉车运输。
P3 夏季高湿模式的紧急停机保护规定，断开循环风扇电源前，操作员要先关闭排液阀 VALVE-S3。指示灯功能保持运行。
P3 冬季高湿模式的前置排液阀为 VALVE-W3。冬季设备密封方案会改变阀门布局。
在 P3 夏季作业中，停机后确保排液阀挂上蓝色锁牌 BLUE-TAG。通知当班交接人并登记。
备用营养剂的领料代码为 REED-NUTRI。应急作业不使用营养剂。
P2 作业必须先关闭排液阀 VALVE-S2，随后登记当地资产编号。
芦苇 P3 场区生产员进入设备间时刷实体证件。紧急停机审批通过后由领班执行上锁。
监控板允许查看作业温度读数。温室没有在此文件里登记图像监控内容。
工单退回后可以在巡检日志追加照片。照片目录由年度计划编号确定。
Nimbus Harbor N6 final import runbook. The quarantine hold for archived manifests in the EU operation is 74 hours. The clock starts at completion of the storage upload.
Nimbus Harbor N6 retired pilot import runbook. The EU quarantine hold for archived manifests was 47 hours under the pilot. This setting expired when the final runbook replaced it.
Nimbus Harbor N6 final import runbook for Canada. The archive-manifest quarantine hold is 62 hours. This timetable is region specific.
Nimbus Harbor N5 final EU import runbook. Archived manifests remain in quarantine for 81 hours. N5 and N6 run independent queues.
The N6 final EU status emitted after a manifest leaves quarantine is MANIFEST-CLEAR. This status is recorded after the hold, during review.
N6 upload reconciliation runs with a daily audit marker HARBOR-AUDIT. The daily review covers archive storage.
The N6 final EU upload log includes MIME type and checksum. The retention time for uploaded data outside quarantine is managed elsewhere.
On a viewing terminal, public manifest listings refresh after an operator chooses Refresh. Viewing a manifest does not end its hold.
Nimbus Harbor N6 final EU recovery procedure. If the quarantine clock is lost during a restart, dispatch the recovery ticket EU-QUAR-REC. This ticket is restricted to the final EU operation.
Nimbus Harbor N6 pilot EU recovery procedure used ticket PILOT-QUAR-REC. This procedure ended with the pilot.
Nimbus N6 final Canadian recovery procedure uses CA-QUAR-REC after a lost quarantine clock. Procedures are regional.
The EU final clock reset requires a supervisor acknowledgement recorded as HARBOR-SUP. A clock reset does not change the normal quarantine duration.
To report a duplicate manifest, submit N6-DUP with the full storage checksum. This process is independent of a lost clock.
Nimbus Harbor's N6 viewing portal uses single sign-on. Operator permissions are supplied by the identity directory.
After a service restart, the estimated queue depth may temporarily drift. The helpdesk owns the review of this reading.
Compliance staff review expiration records each quarter. The report does not specify a maximum upload payload.
Orchid T2 coastal field kit operator manual, revision 12. The external battery pack must deliver at least 57 watt-hours in an approved installation.
Orchid T2 coastal field kit operator manual, superseded revision 11. The external pack capacity floor was 75 watt-hours. Revision 12 replaces this value.
Orchid T2 inland field kit operator manual, revision 12. The external battery capacity floor is 39 watt-hours for inland installations.
An Orchid T2 coastal revision 12 kit is ready after the continuity indicator displays COAST-READY. The display sits above the field reset button.
The inland kit revision 12 continuity indicator reads INLAND-READY at readiness. Contact the warehouse for spare labels.
The coastal revision 12 kit enclosure instruction calls for clockwise removal of the back plate screws. Readiness and battery limits use other steps.
An Orchid T1 coastal kit had a 65 watt-hour battery floor at its latest publication. T1 hardware is not interchangeably configured with T2.
One transport crate may contain a spare mounting frame. Field teams should label the frame separately for the return journey.
Orchid T2 coastal revision 12 launch checklist. Record the first successful enclosure continuity check on form ORC-F12. Submit it before dispatch.
The T2 coastal revision 11 checklist used form ORC-F11 for the first successful continuity check. This form is archived.
Orchid T2 inland revision 12 launch checklist. Use form ORC-I12 to record continuity. Launch forms are issued by the field office.
If a coastal T2 revision 12 enclosure needs to be unlocked, use service token ENC-C12 before removing the battery.
The coastal field kit service desk runs a separate accessory register. A return shipment should include a power-cable receipt.
Field dispatches are planned on the internal scheduling board. Service tokens do not convey permission to transport the kit.
Orchid T2 inland supports a portable hook for unloading. Attachment dimensions are held by the field warehouse.
Archive sign-off is outside the enclosure readiness process. Operators must log the crate tracking identifier after return.
